focus: Realtime midsummer shadow density/contact integrity plus thin-geometry MSAA and LOD stability for native 4K evidence.

implementationCommits.message: Add shadow and thin-geometry stability pass
Enforce shadow stability in cinematic capture pipeline

verification.gitComparison: startHead -> implementationHead is ahead by 3, behind by 0
verification.staticContractChecks: Implemented in QualityBlockShadowStabilityUpgrade.ValidateOpenScene and chained through QualityBlockCinematicImageUpgrade, which is already called by the physical environment/4K capture preparation path.

implementationReadiness.reason: The code/QA contract is present and integrated, but no readiness points are awarded until Unity 6000.3.0f1 compiles/imports and executes it on a real renderer.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.lightingShadowsReflections: Potentially high: four StableFit cascades, VeryHigh shadow maps and a constrained 72 m shadow distance should concentrate sun-shadow precision in benchmark framing while retaining the existing coherent midsummer sun.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLodAliasingStability: Potentially high: Forward MSAA, animated LOD cross-fades and stable shadow projection target rail/sash/grating/branch edge crawl and visible LOD transitions.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryConstruction: Potentially indirect: better contact shadows can expose rather than conceal floating/interpenetrating geometry, improving defect detectability but awarding no geometry points by configuration alone.

criticalFailProtectionAdded: Severe aliasing/shimmering remains an automatic FAIL and must be judged from actual render evidence.
Visible LOD pop remains an automatic FAIL; all multi-level benchmark LOD groups are required to use animated cross-fade.
Major light leak/contact detachment remains an automatic FAIL; sun bias values are bounded by QA rather than arbitrarily increased.
Transparent facade glazing is prohibited from casting opaque card shadows.
No blur, post sharpening or painted contact shadows are introduced to hide instability.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/import and actual 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture. Review 100% crops for shadow acne/peter-panning, rail/sash/grating/branch stair-stepping, contact leaks and LOD stability. If runtime remains unavailable, the next safe score-oriented target is causal facade/balcony weathering and material variation rather than more post-processing.
externalTechnicalBasis: Unity Built-in Render Pipeline exposes StableFit shadow projection, four directional shadow cascades, VeryHigh shadow resolution and per-light shadow bias controls.
Built-in Forward rendering supports multisample anti-aliasing, while 4K capture separately records the actually supported RenderTexture MSAA sample count.
Reducing shadow distance concentrates shadow-map texel density within the camera-relevant region; the 72 m handoff is aligned with the existing atmospheric fog start.
